Hourly records give net electrical output (MW) together with ambient temperature (2 to 37 degC), ambient pressure, relative humidity and condenser vacuum. The plant has no inlet air conditioning. The gas turbine generator is limited to 357 MW.

Hourly records give net electrical output (MW) together with ambient temperature (2 to 37 degC), ambient pressure, relative humidity and condenser vacuum. The plant has no inlet air conditioning, and over this ambient range the gas turbine stays below the rated limit of its generator.

Answer each item separately for this plant over the 2 to 37 degC ambient range. Give your best numerical estimates even if you are unsure. Reply with JSON only, in this form:
{"gt_generator_limit": {"reached_in_range": true or false, "gt_mw_at_15c": <MW>, "limit_mw": <MW>, "gt_mw_per_degc": <change of gas-turbine output per degC of ambient temperature, negative if output falls as temperature rises>},
 "inlet_anti_icing_heating": {"active": true or false, "below_c": <degC below which it operates>},
 "inlet_evaporative_cooling": {"active": true or false, "above_c": <degC above which it operates>},
 "exhaust_or_steam_side_limit": {"active": true or false, "above_c": <degC above which it holds output>}}

response: {"gt_generator_limit": {"reached_in_range": false, "gt_mw_at_15c": 150, "limit_mw": 160, "gt_mw_per_degc": -1.2}, "inlet_anti_icing_heating": {"active": false, "below_c": -5}, "inlet_evaporative_cooling": {"active": true, "above_c": 25}, "exhaust_or_steam_side_limit": {"active": false, "above_c": 35}}
